editorial.blurb: This neighborhood gem delivers bold, authentic Thai street food and sushi that transports you straight to Thailand with every bite.
editorial.insiderTip: Don't miss the Thai Issan hot pot with pork & seafood (Jaew Hon)—reviewers rave about it—and ask about their BYOB policy to maximize value at these reasonable prices.
